about: One 10 s window of the licence-clean Bach clip (tools/studio/make_test_audio.py): the INT8 transcription model's raw outputs and what piano_transcription_inference's RegressionPostProcessor makes of this single window (no stitching). Sparse outputs are 0 wherever the post-processor never reads them (the reconstruction was checked to give the same notes). Input: transcription_window.wav read as int16 / 32768.
expected_notes_order: by key (A0 up), then onset: RegressionPostProcessor's own order
